//: Template. Copy to appsettings.Secrets.json (git-ignored) and fill in. The app refuses to start while a required value is empty.

JWT.//: Random string, at least 32 characters. PowerShell: [Convert]::ToBase64String([Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator]::GetBytes(64))

MailSettings.//: SMTP account used to send emails. For Gmail use an App Password (Google Account -> Security -> App passwords), not your normal password.

Twilio.//: From https://console.twilio.com: Account SID, Auth Token and your Twilio number in E.164 format (+15551234567).

GoogleAuth.//: OAuth 2.0 Client ID(s) from Google Cloud Console -> APIs & Services -> Credentials, e.g. 1234-abc.apps.googleusercontent.com

Stripe.//: Test-mode keys from https://dashboard.stripe.com/test/apikeys (sk_test_... / pk_test_...). WebhookSecret (whsec_...) is printed by `stripe listen --forward-to https://localhost:7250/api/payments/webhooks/stripe`, or shown on the webhook endpoint in the dashboard.

Seed.//: Admin account created on first start. Password: 8+ chars with upper, lower, digit and symbol.
Seed.//DevUsersPassword: Password for the test teachers/students seeded in Development (same rules).
